item.title: OpenRouter 实测 RAG 重排序：274 题基准中 precision@1 从 81% 提升到 97% / Reranking in RAG: How to Fix Bad Retrieval with a Reranker
item.description: When a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) app gives wrong answers even though the right information is in your documents, retrieval is often the cause. Vector search is great at finding chunks on the right topic, but it often falls for near misses, like pulling the bucket limit for the Enterprise plan when the user asked about the Growth plan. Reranking in RAG fixes this by taking your vector search’s top 30 candidates and passing them through a dedicated cross-encoder model that re-scores eac（OpenRouter Blog）

item.title: 黄仁勋辞去英伟达总裁兼CEO，作者梳理14天风波始末
